counterfactual.change: Reduced initial vx from 55.087 to 10.0 only; same steps/dt/geometry. Scenario sa36cebd071 passes with no violation, showing failure requires high approach speed.

explanation: Fast body (~55 m/s, ~0.26 m/step, 9 substeps) reaches the right boundary around step 30 with small penetration but the boundary-wall collision impulse never fires: vx is identical at steps 0,28,29,30,31. With no velocity reflection or effective positional correction, the body coasts straight through and exceeds the 0.15 in_arena tolerance at step 31 (overshoot 0.31). Likely cause is missed discrete boundary contact at high speed / failed substep collision handling.
vision_note: The red ball drifts rightward toward the arena's right boundary from steps 28 to 30 and makes contact at the edge. At step 31 it continues straight through and sits half outside the wall with no bounce or deflection.
